test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: The deseasonalised time-series data will have only trend (T), cyclical (C) and irregular (I) components and is expressed as:
solution:
The de-seasonalized time-series data is a transformation of original time-series data to remove the impact of seasonality. The resulting time-series will only

have the trend (T), cyclical (C), and irregular (I) components. The equation T.C.I x 100 represents the decomposition of the time-series

data into these three components, where the multiplication by 100 is used to express the values as percentages.
